changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'analytics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Action') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [analytics].[Action]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Value] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Analytics_Action] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_Analytics_Action') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_Analytics_Action] ON [analytics].[Action] ( [Value] ASC ) END
